newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hackman's Hadwaco says has U.S. partner.
newsitem.headline: Hackman's Hadwaco says has U.S. partner.

text.p: Finnish diversified group Oy Hackman Ab said on Tuesday its Hadwaco environmental technology unit had sealed a marketing partnership with United States Filter Corporation.
"Hadwaco and its subsidiary Hadwaco US Inc ... signed an agreement on worldwide marketing cooperation with the American company United States Filter Corporation," Hackman said in a statement.

"U.S. Filter/HPD will incorporate the Hadwaco technology into its treatment systems and market the technology through more than 350 global sales, service and distribution outlets in 28 countries," Hackman said.
U.S. Filter, based in Palm Desert, California, designs, engineers and builds custom evaporation and crystallization systems and had 1996 net sales of more than $2 billion.
Hackman also said in the statement it had appointed Lauri Prepula from Avainlaskelmat Oy to be Hadwaco's new managing director.
